plan: Deep-copy input data on initialization and store it internally.
Implement helper functions for traversal, finding items, and validating moves.
Implement total_word_count by recursively summing note word counts and reference word counts.
Implement unresolved_markers by collecting markers from notes and references, deduplicating, and sorting.
Implement outline by recursively rendering items with indentation based on depth.
Implement move with validation: check ids, destination container, index range, and cycle prevention.
Implement to_data returning a deep copy of internal data.
Ensure all operations are deterministic and use only standard library.
mechanisms: Deep copy on init to isolate internal state.
Recursive traversal for counting, marker collection, and outline generation.
Validation checks before any mutation to guarantee atomicity.
Cycle detection by checking if destination is inside the moving subtree.
Deterministic ordering via list order and sorted markers.
